title: 417. Verify Preorder Serialization of a Binary Tree

examples.explanation: Every real node provides two child slots and every marker consumes one, ending exactly balanced.
Only one child token follows the root, so one required slot is never filled.
The tree finishes after three tokens, leaving the final value orphaned.

hints: Track open slots: start with one, spend one per token, and add two for each real node.
Fail early when slots go negative, and accept only when exactly zero remain at the end.
